description: Urinary energy (UE) as a fraction of GE. Default follows IPCC 2006 p. 10.54: UE=0.04 typical; UE=0.02 when DE% is greater than approximately 80%. holos_as_coded switches on grain fraction (>=85% grain -> 0.02, else 0.04). The 0.02/0.04 pairing is the same direction as IPCC; the discrepancy is the switch criterion (grain% vs DE%), not a reversal of the two values.

options.source_correct: IPCC 2006 Vol 4 Ch 10 p. 10.54: UE=0.04 GE typical; UE=0.02 when DE% > ~80%
options.holos_as_coded: Holos: UE=0.02 when grain% >= 85, else UE=0.04
